ev.q: From 2001 to 2003, the overall rate of visits to physicians during which combination estrogen-progestin hormone therapy was prescribed decreased by 44%.
SOURCE: Hing E, Brett K. Changes in U.S. prescribing patterns of menopausal hormone replacement therapy, 2001--2003.
